checkpoint_review: The Router was generally accurate but slightly too rigid on the '10x length' checkpoint. While the space bar is not literally 10x the width of a key in this cropped view (it's closer to 4-5x due to perspective and keyboard type), it functionally serves as the space bar. I will treat this as a 'pass' for alignment because the object is correctly identified and positioned, even if the strict geometric ratio isn't met due to form factor variation. The Router correctly marked the underside mechanism as untestable. All other checkpoints were correctly verified.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified text gibberish on the surrounding keys (Severity 2). However, the Router underestimated the structural integrity issue at the bottom-left corner. The Topology Boundary Auditor returned a high confidence mask (0.993), which might suggest a clean boundary, but visual inspection reveals the space bar's left edge blends into the shadow/chassis area without a crisp mechanical gap. This is a subtle 'fusion' artifact common in AI keyboards where dark objects meet dark backgrounds. I am upgrading the severity of the boundary issue from 1 to 2. The perspective distortion noted by the Router is minor (Severity 1) and acceptable.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'space bar' (Logit 7.71 vs 6.66 for keyboard). The object is blank, rectangular, and centrally positioned. The failure of the strict '10x length' metric is disregarded as a non-critical variance in keyboard design/cropping. The subject is structurally coherent and clearly identifiable.
artifact_reasoning: Primary artifacts are contextual: malformed Cyrillic text on adjacent keys (confirmed by Image Text Auditor with low confidence 0.52). Secondary artifact is slight edge fusion/bleeding between the space bar and the left modifier key/chassis, which the Router noted but under-severed. The high mask confidence from the Topology Auditor masks this subtle blending issue. No catastrophic melting or structural collapse of the target subject itself.
key_defects: Slight edge fusion/blur between space bar and left adjacent key
